title: Imaginate — Sprint 1: Core Engine
description: End-to-end Python CLI pipeline on Qwen Cloud: prompt → story → scenes + bible → character-consistent images → TTS narration → HTML storybook

stories.title: Project scaffold, config, and Qwen client
stories.description: Create project directory structure, settings loader, and reusable Qwen Cloud API client
acceptanceCriteria: imaginate-ai/ directory exists with shared/config/settings.py that loads DASHSCOPE_API_KEY from .env
agent_orchestrator/qwen_client.py has QwenClient class supporting chat completions (qwen3.7-max), image generation (qwen-image-2.0-pro), and TTS
QwenClient handles API errors with retry logic (max 3 retries)
requirements.txt lists: openai, python-dotenv, requests

stories.title: Data models for story pipeline
stories.description: Shared data models for Story, Scene, Character, CharacterBible, ImageRecord, PipelineState with JSON serialization
acceptanceCriteria: shared/models/story.py defines: Story, Scene, Character, CharacterBible dataclasses with to_dict/from_dict methods
shared/models/pipeline.py defines: PipelineState with stage tracking, slug, status enum, serialization
ImageRecord model stores: scene_index, prompt, image_url, seed, character_name, validation_status
All models serialize to/from JSON for persistence

stories.title: Story script generator
stories.description: Qwen3.7-max structured output to generate full story script with scenes, characters, and bible from a user prompt
acceptanceCriteria: script_generator/script_generator.py takes a user prompt string and age group (kids/adult)
Uses qwen3.7-max with structured JSON output to produce: title, characters[], scenes[] with text/description/mood
CharacterBible includes: name, age, appearance details
Test with prompt produces valid output files

stories.title: Image generation with character consistency
stories.description: Qwen Image 2.0 Pro pipeline: generate character reference images then scene images
acceptanceCriteria: image_generation/qwen_image_client.py generates images via qwen-image-2.0-pro model
image_generation/character_consistency/reference_manager.py generates one reference image per character
image_generation/character_consistency/prompt_assembler.py builds scene prompts with character descriptions from bible
image_generation/character_consistency/continuity_classifier.py classifies each scene
All images save as PNG in story output directory

stories.title: TTS narration
acceptanceCriteria: Generates one MP3 per scene
Output files named {slug}_part_NN.mp3
All 8/8 scenes in test received TTS

stories.title: HTML storybook exporter
stories.description: Self-contained HTML storybook with embedded images and audio
acceptanceCriteria: Single self-contained HTML file with page-flip navigation
8 images + 8 audio clips embedded as base64
Works offline, mobile-friendly with swipe

stories.title: End-to-end orchestrator CLI
acceptanceCriteria: CLI entry: python -m imaginate runs full pipeline
Pipeline state persisted after each phase
Final output is a single HTML file with all assets
Verified: 8 scenes, 8 images, 8 audio, 20.9MB HTML
